title: Media Downloader Plugin getfile.php dl_file_resumable cross site scripting
description: A vulnerability was found in Media Downloader Plugin 0.1.992 on WordPress. It has been declared as problematic. This vulnerability affects the function dl_file_resumable of the file getfile.php. The manipulation of the argument file leads to cross site scripting. The attack can be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 0.1.993 is able to address this issue. The patch is identified as 77beb720c682b9300035ab5f96eee225181d8a92. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component. VDB-222262 is the identifier assigned to this vulnerability.
